---
title: "TAF readiness"
---

The [TAF readiness level](../system/readiness-level.qmd) of the stock assessment repositories in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf), by assessment year.

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")

repos <- read.csv("../_generated/taf-repos.csv")

levels <- c("No level", paste("Level", 1:4))
colours <- setNames(c("#d5d4ce", "#9ec5f4", "#3987e5", "#1c5cab", "#0d366b"), levels)
repos$level <- factor(ifelse(is.na(repos$trl), 0, repos$trl), 0:4, levels)

n <- table(repos$level)
at_least <- function(level) sum(repos$trl >= level, na.rm = TRUE)
untested <- sum(repos$trl %in% 1 & !repos$qc_tested)

# the assessments, shared by the chart and the table so that clicking a bar
# filters the table
assessments <- data.frame(
  Year = as.character(repos$year),
  Stock = ifelse(is.na(repos$part), repos$stock, paste0(repos$stock, " (", repos$part, ")")),
  Level = repos$level,
  Published = ifelse(repos$published, "Published", "Not published"),
  QC = ifelse(!repos$qc_tested, "Not tested", ifelse(repos$qc_passed, "Passed", "Failed"))
)
names(assessments)[5] <- "QC test"
shared <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(assessments)

# the bars: the number of assessments by year and level, stacked by hand so
# that a clicked bar is highlighted in place. Each bar carries the keys of its
# assessments, which is what links it to the rows of the table.
bars <- aggregate(
  list(key = shared$key()),
  assessments[c("Level", "Year", "Published")],
  function(x) I(list(x))
)
bars$n <- lengths(bars$key)
bars <- bars[order(bars$Published, bars$Year, bars$Level), ]
bars$base <- ave(bars$n, bars$Published, bars$Year, FUN = function(n) cumsum(n) - n)

# one panel of the chart, with a set of bars for each level
panel <- function(published, legend) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (level in levels(droplevels(assessments$Level))) {
    p <- p |>
      add_bars(
        data = crosstalk::SharedData$new(
          bars[bars$Published == published & bars$Level == level, ],
          key = ~key, group = shared$groupName()
        ),
        x = ~Year, y = ~n, base = ~base,
        name = level, marker = list(color = colours[[level]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
        legendgroup = level, showlegend = legend,
        customdata = ~n, hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{customdata} repositories"
      )
  }
  p |>
    layout(
      barmode = "overlay",
      xaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "category ascending"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Assessment repositories")
    )
}
```

There are `r nrow(repos)` stock assessment repositories.

- `r at_least(1)` have reached level 1, with their code on GitHub.
- `r at_least(2)` of those have reached level 2, passing the QC test. `r untested` of the repositories at level 1 have not been tested.
- None has been tested for level 3 yet.
- `r n[["No level"]]` have no level, because they have no `model.R` script or only an empty one.

`r sum(repos$published)` of the repositories are for stocks published in [ices-advice](https://github.com/ices-advice): `r sum(repos$published & repos$trl %in% 2)` at level 2, `r sum(repos$published & repos$trl %in% 1)` at level 1 and `r sum(repos$published & is.na(repos$trl))` with no level.

The QC results are from `r format(as.Date(max(repos$qc_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "%e %B %Y")`.

Click a bar to list its assessments in the table below. To show them all again, use the button above the table or double-click the chart.

```{r}
#| echo: false
# the published assessments only go back a few years
subplot(panel("Published", TRUE), panel("Not published", FALSE), shareY = TRUE, widths = c(0.28, 0.72), margin = 0.03) |>
  layout(
    annotations = list(
      list(text = "<b>Published</b>", x = 0, xref = "x domain", y = 1.04, yref = "paper", xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE),
      list(text = "<b>Not published</b>", x = 0, xref = "x2 domain", y = 1.04, yref = "paper", xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE)
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.12, traceorder = "normal"),
    margin = list(t = 40),
    font = list(family = "inherit"),
    hoverlabel = list(namelength = -1),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
  ) |>
  highlight(
    on = "plotly_click", off = "plotly_doubleclick", opacityDim = 0.35,
    selected = attrs_selected(showlegend = FALSE)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, doubleClickDelay = 1000)
```
